title: D-branes in $AdS_2 \times H^2 \times H^2$ under the non-Abelian T-duality
summary: We proceed to construct a non-Abelian dual pair for the $AdS_2 \times H^2 \times H^2$ background by applying the non-Abelian T-duality (here as Poisson-Lie T-duality on a semi-Abelian double). By using a certain parameterization of the $6$-dimensional Lie group ${A}_2 \otimes {A}_2 \otimes A_2$ we construct the original $σ$-model including the $AdS_2 \times H^2 \times H^2$ metric in the absence of $B$-field.
